verdict.rationale: Docs mention that controls can contain 'custom content' that persists independently of frameworks (oneleet-docs-15/25/39), implying some ability to add custom controls, but there is no documentation of creating custom frameworks, defining custom tests, or setting custom evidence requirements. missing for 10: explicit custom-framework creation workflow, custom test/evidence-requirement definition UI or API, and any example of a user-defined framework alongside built-ins.
